title: 0802 Step 1-1 · Dense 474M · nested 3B pool
setup: Dense 474M; nested 3B pool = sealed 1B + disjoint new 2B; sequence length 4096; global batches 64, 128, 256, and 512 sequences.
selection: LR is frozen to the selected 1B-pool value for the same model and batch. At E1 branch the exact selected 1B pre-decay model/optimizer checkpoint: continue once at the selected WD and once with WD lowered by one ladder step. At later frontiers compare the selected WD with at most one higher ladder step, capped by the same-epoch 1B WD. Stop on validation-CE non-improvement or at the same-model/same-batch 1B optimum.

healthAudit.criterion: Orange is advisory for a visually persistent but not clearly divergent pattern across smoothed CE and gradient norm. A scalar tail delta or isolated gradient spike alone is not enough. Orange runs remain eligible and are not stopped automatically. Red means sustained late gradient-norm instability with accompanying CE degradation; ordinary warmup and isolated transient spikes are ignored. Red runs are excluded from endpoint selection.
healthAudit.trajectoryPolicy: Once a run is marked unhealthy, do not continue that exact model/regime/LR/WD trajectory to a later epoch.

healthAudit.criterion: Orange is advisory for a visually persistent but not clearly divergent pattern across smoothed CE and gradient norm. A scalar tail delta or isolated gradient spike alone is not enough. Orange runs remain eligible and are not stopped automatically. Red means sustained late gradient-norm instability with accompanying CE degradation; ordinary warmup and isolated transient spikes are ignored. Red runs are excluded from endpoint selection.
